verdict.rationale:
ClickHouse Cloud documentation explicitly states compute and storage scale down to zero when idle so users don't pay for idle services, directly matching the zero-cost-when-idle founder story, and separate storage/compute architecture implies durable storage persists independent of compute scaling.  
missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a ClickHouse Cloud service actually resumes from zero with data intact, and explicit documentation of the resume latency/behavior for a paused service.
